name: YouTube Video Transcript & Actionable Steps (Whisper)
description: Downloads the audio of a YouTube video (yt-dlp), normalizes it (ffmpeg), transcribes it locally with OpenAI Whisper (small model), and has AI extract actionable steps and rules from the content.
analysis_prompt: You are analyzing a transcript of a YouTube video (Self-host your own Git platform! // Gitea Tutorial, by Christian Lempa). The data contains one video_metadata record (title, channel, duration, url) and many transcript_segment records (start, end, text) in chronological order. Reconstruct the full narrative from the segments, then extract a clear, actionable set of steps and rules a viewer should follow to replicate what is demonstrated (e.g., setup steps, configuration choices, commands, best practices, gotchas/warnings mentioned). Organize the output as: 1) a one-paragraph overview of the video's purpose, 2) a numbered list of actionable steps in the order they should be performed, 3) a list of extracted rules/best-practices/warnings with supporting evidence (quote or paraphrase from the transcript, with approximate timestamp), and 4) any tools, commands, or configuration values explicitly mentioned.
